rationale: Crawler navigated off-site to monclergroup.com, likely via brand/external link. We add strict domain allowlist, block external navigations, and constrain PLP clicks to Target PDP anchors (/p/). We normalize URLs, strip locale traps, and add robust, minimal selectors for Target PLP/PDP along with explicit wait_for anchors. The code hint addresses the missing _force_plp_recover attribute and adds a safe recovery path plus off-domain navigation guards.
code_hints: Guard missing recovery method: replace direct calls to self._force_plp_recover() with if hasattr(self, 'force_plp_recover'): self.force_plp_recover(ctx) elif hasattr(self, '_force_plp_recover'): self._force_plp_recover(ctx)

Add domain-allowlist navigation guard: on each navigation or click, if new URL hostname not in allowed_domains, preventDefault or page.goBack(); prefer evaluating anchors and filtering to href^='/p/' on PLP.
When extracting PLP items, querySelectorAll('a[href^="/p/"]') and de-duplicate by pathname; avoid any anchors that resolve to external hosts.

On PDP, wait for h1[data-test='product-title'] before price; if price selector not found, attempt reading from JSON-LD: find script[type='application/ld+json'] containing "@type":"Product" and parse offers.price.
Implement a generic modal dismiss routine that clicks selectors from settings.dismiss_modals if present, retried before giving up PLP detection.
Set Accept-Language header and en_US cookie before first navigation to stabilize content and reduce locale-driven redirects.
